pinewood.name: Misty Pinewood
pinewood.sub: The trees are leaning away from something

objects.label: sign
objects.text: North: Troll Hollow. Mind the creek.

objects.label: lore
objects.title: Warden stone
objects.text: Bramblehorn kept the roots. He loved the roots too much.

pinewood.objective: Follow the animals north along the dirt road.

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: The animals are running.
Something big has woken in the wood.

actions.text: Checkpoint: Glade of Arrival
Follow the animals north along the dirt road.

actions.title: Fishing
actions.sub: Stand at the water and Interact

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: Ripples, Aerin. Fish are still here.
Fishing wakes in a later dream.

actions.text: Checkpoint: The road to the plaza

actions.title: Ogre!
actions.sub: A brute guards the sunlit clearing

actions.text: Heavy footsteps echo to the north...
Follow the road north to the stone plaza

actions.title: The Stone Plaza
actions.sub: Kill the shaman first: it keeps the boar standing

actions.text: The way to the grove is clear.
Enter the Warden's Grove (north-east)

actions.title: The Warden's Grove
actions.sub: A shaman chants in the dark

actions.text: The shaman falls silent.
Take the rift down into the Root Hollow (key from the elite ogre)

actions.title: Thornback Boars
actions.sub: Arrows glance off their bristles (resist pierce)

actions.text: The ford is quiet again.

actions.title: Gnarlroot Ogre
actions.sub: Guardian of the Root Hollow key

actions.text: The ogre drops a gnarled root key.

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: That key smells of roots and earth. It opens the Root Hollow.

actions.text: Find the way down: the Root Hollow door

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: The wall hums, Aerin. Something is hidden behind it.

actions.text: A hidden gem cache!

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: A light off the road, Aerin. Worth the detour.

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: The bridge is raised. There must be a lever somewhere.

actions.text: A gold chest!

pinewood_boss.name: Bramblehorn's Court
pinewood_boss.sub: Where the old troll king holds his root-throne

actions.title: Bramblehorn's Court
actions.sub: Where the old troll king holds his root-throne

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: Aerin... the ground is shaking. That is the troll king.

actions.text: Checkpoint: Bramblehorn's Court

actions.title: Old Bramblehorn
actions.sub: The Troll King - Shard of Root

actions.text: Defeat Old Bramblehorn

actions.title: Victory
actions.sub: The Shard of Root is relit

actions.title: The Pinewood Shard
actions.text: The Shard of Root is relit.
Take the rift to the Gloomspire Ruins, or return home

vale.name: Whispering Vale
vale.sub: A dream drifting above the clouds

objects.title: Elder Stone
objects.label: elder stone
objects.text: The Stone knows her. The Stone does not say. Past the cottage, where the path ends, a light waits.

objects.label: sign
objects.text: Training yard east. Elder Stone north-east.

objects.label: lore
objects.title: Tablet
objects.text: Four Wardens. One would not wake.

vale.objective: Wake up. Training dummies wait in the yard.

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: Training dummies are east. Hit one.

actions.text: Hit the training dummies in the yard.
Checkpoint: Whispering Vale

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: Swing. Then dodge. Then try your Q skill.
The dummy never hits back. Lucky thing.

actions.text: Follow the path north to the Elder Plaza.

actions.speaker: Elder Stone
lines: The Stone lost a light. Past the cottage, a path ends.

actions.text: Open the chest north-east. Then find the Stone's lantern.

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: A chest! Interact to open it.

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: Open your bag and equip it.

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: Ripples. Fishing waits in the Pinewood.

actions.text: A hidden gem cache!

actions.title: Gloom in the garden
actions.sub: Slimes ooze out of the flowers

actions.text: The garden is quiet. Something hums in the south.
Take the rift south into the Misty Pinewood.
The Stone's lantern, still warm.
Return the lantern to the Elder Stone.

actions.speaker: Elder Stone
lines: The Stone is lit. The Stone remembers kindness.

actions.text: Reward: a gem and a Socket Rune.

roothollow.name: Root Hollow
roothollow.sub: Where the old roots drink the dark

objects.label: lore
objects.title: Warden stone
objects.text: The first Warden sealed Mossjaw here to keep the Gloam from the pines.

roothollow.objective: Open the root door and descend.

actions.title: Root Hollow
actions.sub: Where the old roots drink the dark

actions.text: Open the root door and descend.
A door of knotted roots. It needs the Root Hollow key.
Checkpoint: Root Hollow midpoint
The roots go still.
Rest at the shrine, then press on

actions.title: The Gallery
actions.sub: Something large is sleeping at the far end

actions.text: Silence. A lever waits nearby.
Find the lever that raises the gate

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: The gate is knotted shut. Find a lever.

actions.text: Defeat Mossjaw

actions.speaker: Mossjaw
lines: The roots remember the first Warden... he did not wake, and neither shall I.

actions.text: Take the rift down to Old Bramblehorn

actions.speaker: Pip
lines: The wall hums, Aerin. Something is hidden behind it.

actions.text: A Socket Rune!
